title: eragrostis australasica
intro: Eragrostis australasica, commonly known as Kangaroo Grass, is a type of perennial grass native to Australia. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing inflammation and protecting cells from damage. The therapeutic actions of Kangaroo Grass are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which may help to soothe and calm the body. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of this plant on human health.
